repository_sources.use: Intrinsic full source, indecomposable actual image, normalized compact top cycle and full original-marker interpretation.
Exact source/core finish line, finite quotient descent and no local exponential-monodromy shortcut.
Actual compact Cauchy period regularity and the principal-part/zero integer-log retraction; keep the complement system distinct from fibre data.
Every nonconstant eventually pure phase is non-tame and has an original-unit origin V defect; that defect is not identified wholesale with the new nearby-fibre boundary image.

primary_sources.author: Allen Hatcher
primary_sources.title: Algebraic Topology
primary_sources.read: Author-hosted 560-page version, including 2015 reprinting notice, pinned by hash. Theorem 3.43 printed 254/PDF263; Section 4.D printed 440-444/PDF449-453, especially Corollary 4D.9 and Theorem 4D.10, read.
primary_sources.exact_import: Oriented Thom class and pair exact sequence; Poincare--Lefschetz duality for the compact four-dimensional fibre core. The ordinary homological tube sequence is derived fibrewise in the note, not confused with Borel--Moore homology. The new linking-functional and monodromy identities are proved by compact chain intersections.

primary_sources.author: Claude Sabbah
primary_sources.title: Vanishing Cycles of Polynomial Maps: Topology, Hodge Structure, D-Modules
primary_sources.read: Section 1.3 printed 2/PDF8 and Section 1.4 printed 3/PDF9 read, with earlier source audit retained.
primary_sources.exact_import: Smooth affine nearby surfaces have CW dimension at most two; full finite bifurcation set includes infinity. Pair/complement local systems are obtained by the same stratified proper-compactification construction; no tameness or properness of P is assumed.

new_written_arguments: Integral exact tube extension 0 H2(F) -> H3(X minus F) -> Z ->0, surjective because the actual compact Haar cycle lifts at a large parameter; H2(F) and H3(complement) are free.

All original Cauchy forms and their parameter derivatives span full top de Rham cohomology of the complement. Safety iff the actual Haar cycle has zero local monodromy motion; that motion is Tube(d_P) for one integral cycle.
On the pure locus, the actual generalized eigenvalue-1 component d_(P,1) vanishes iff the entire motion vanishes, by the retained integer-log retraction.
Canonical integral linking exists because H2(X)=0 and odd rank-one H3 intersection is zero. Naturality gives B(d,T beta)=ell(beta)-ell(T beta).

If fibre monodromy is semisimple at 1, d_(P,1) lies in the invariant intersection radical, which equals the image of H2 of a compact fibre boundary. Vanishing of this invariant image is a complete sufficient all-marker condition.
Finite-cover transfer takes the actual quotient Haar variation to the SL2 Haar variation; the obstruction is already Gamma-invariant and cannot be killed by nontrivial characters.
not_claimed: Sufficient fibre/boundary hypotheses for every pure phase
Arbitrary replacement of the Haar lift by a fixed lift
Semisimplicity of fibre monodromy alone suffices
A general identification of the origin V defect with boundary cycles
